QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Restoring the Blue Dragon Cannon
QuestInfo.0: Can you learn how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon from #bEurenth#k this time? Listen in #b#m401020100##k.
QuestInfo.1:
You received documents that explain how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon written from Eurenth. Hurry and show them to #bEdea#k in the #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k.

#r#e*If you fail, forfeit the quest and start over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: You handed the Blue Dragon Cannon repair plans to Edea. You also found out that Edea was Eurenth's student.

npc.0: Didn't you go back to #bEdea#k yet? She should be somewhere in the Reclamation HQ.

item.0: Did you find out how to #brestore the Blue Dragon Cannon#k? I'm sure that old man #bEurenth#k knows it.
